简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Axern is open-source, self-hosted infrastructure for **single-host agent execution and persistent wo"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"rkspaces**. It provides isolated execution through gVisor (`runsc`) and experimental single-writer W"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"orkspace resources. The CLI and Go, Python, and TypeScript SDKs expose the same public APIs for Envi"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"ronments, Runs, sandbox processes and files, Tunnels, lifecycle state, and Allocation-scoped access."},{"id":"p3s5","text":" gVisor/runsc is the sole long-term execution backend."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The primary use case is a personal agent system on one Linux host: independent workers, inspectable "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"execution, retained working data, and a small operational surface. Agent sessions, configuration, pl"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"anning, collaboration, and workflows belong to caller applications. See the product direction and si"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ngle-host serving decision."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Project status:** Axern is pre-1.0 and under active development. An experimental native Linux in"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"stallation provides a source-built runtime archive and managed systemd lifecycle. It is not yet a pu"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"blished release channel or a supported upgrade path. Docker Compose remains the local development pa"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"th. Optional Workspace data requires XFS project quotas; other writable storage is Allocation-local."},{"id":"p5s5","text":" Supported backup/restore and upgrades remain unqualified, and sealed outputs expire 15 minutes afte"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"r cleanup begins. Review the current deployment and storage boundaries before use."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The durable chain is **Environment → Run → Allocation → runsc sandbox**. Operate the installed server with `axern server start`, `status`, `logs` and `stop`. API contexts"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" select remote execution services; they do not change the host managed by `server`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Use the CLI, services and SDKs from one coordinated release or source revision. For repository devel"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"opment on Linux or a macOS Linux VM, use Go 1.26.10, Make and Docker Compose v2:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"`quickstart-source` builds current service images and verifies the source Compose stack. The package"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"d Compose lifecycle is `axern dev up|status|logs|down`; it is separate from the installed server and"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" retains the machine-local context/data identity. A published CLI's development bundle requires its "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"matching published service images. See the CLI contract for deployment commands and contexts."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Workspace usage covers retained files through fresh Runs. Without a Workspace, existing ephemeral ex"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ecution stays available. Agent programs, tasks and session recovery remain caller-owned."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"For repository development, `make verify-changed` is the normal fast feedback entrypoint. Linux corr"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ectness, full regression, and release qualification are separate tiers. Every `main` commit starts a"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" commit-bound full regression; a green PR check does not imply that this later run has passed. Check"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" Post-Merge Full before release or promotion; see the verification tiers."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What You Can Build"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Agent sandboxes:** execute agent-generated code behind a runsc isolation boundary while retainin"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"g process, file, terminal, and output APIs.
- **Concurrent agent tasks:** execute coding, research, "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"evaluation, or data processing work through independent Runs, with explicit inputs, outputs, and lif"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ecycle evidence.
- **SDK-driven execution:** use a released SDK to create Runs, operate their Alloca"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"tions, seal bounded declared outputs, publish a successful writable rootfs as a reusable Environment"},{"id":"p17s6","text":", and recover by public resource identity."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Why Axern"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Execution for your agent system:** compose isolated agent tasks through the same Run execution m"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"odel while keeping planning, memory, and collaboration in your application.
- **Durable control plan"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"e:** PostgreSQL-backed intent, placement, leases, allocation-scoped status, health, and cleanup stat"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"e remain authoritative across process or node restarts.
- **One production runtime:** runsc workload"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"s use the same public APIs; OCI images provide reproducible rootfs inputs.
- **Real data-plane acces"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"s:** process streams, files, archives, SSH-compatible terminals, and reverse TCP tunnels are explici"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"t allocation capabilities.
- **A focused direction:** prioritize simpler single-host deployment and "},{"id":"p19s8","text":"persistent working data; existing Compose, kind, and Helm deployment contracts remain documented whi"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"le that work is implemented."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`gatewayd` is the unified external gateway for public control and Allocation-scoped data-plane traff"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ic; `controld` and PostgreSQL remain authoritative for product state, while node services own host-l"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ocal execution, images, networking, and Allocation-local writable storage. A Run can declare a bound"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ed set of files or tar archives for node-local sealing before runtime cleanup; callers download and "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"durably publish those bytes before the reported output expiry, which is 15 minutes after cleanup beg"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ins. A successful finite Run may separately publish its complete writable rootfs as a content-addres"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"sed OCI image and ordinary reusable Environment. Neither path creates a persistent workspace or gene"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ric object store. See the storage architecture, runtime architecture, and resource model."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Public clients are available in Go, Python, and TypeScript under `sdk/`. Shared wire contracts are d"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"efined in `sdk/proto`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Kubernetes Install"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Follow the Kubernetes installation guide to provision signing material, supply qualified node memory"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" reserves, bind explicit Node identities, install the control plane, and admit nodes before waiting "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"for runtime readiness. SSH is optional and uses Principal Credentials. Do not skip the identity and "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"admission steps by running a bare Helm install."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Treat each Axern release as one coordinated CLI, SDK, chart, and runtime version.
